title: HTTP server flips health first, then shuts down within a deadline
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the atomic flag or the final Close call as belt-and-braces excess. The order is the point: the health endpoint starts returning 503 the moment shutdown begins, so the load balancer drains this instance before connections are closed; Shutdown then waits for in-flight requests up to the 15s deadline and only on deadline expiry is the forceful Close used; ErrServerClosed from the serving goroutine is the expected termination signal and is filtered explicitly rather than treated as a crash.
